test_gtn_graph_equality: test two gtn graphs for equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes arcs and weights
test_gtn_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn graphs for isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic ignoring node ordering
test_gtn_loadtxt_savetxt: test loading and saving gtn graphs to text format using gtn.loadtxt and gtn.savetxt
test_gtn_save_load: test serializing and deserializing gtn graphs using gtn.save and gtn.load to a file
test_gtn_graph_construction: test building gtn graphs with add_node and add_arc including start accept and epsilon labels
